items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I got in Horace Henderson's band. And we were working a place called Dunbar Palace... So we played, stayed together for quite some time.

ctx.x: You mean you went back with Billy Fowler's band?
No, I went with Billy Fowler's band, I had come back in '29. Now Horace Henderson, Fletcher Henderson's brother, he assembled a band. And so I got in that band.
So this was after Lucky Roberts?
